source_text.GH#2702: Hide synthetic entity-type instances from every Instances route. Test-design validation (static; mix not run).

task.description: WF-02 step 3b gate on TEST-DESIGNER output for GH #2702. Read-only, static reasoning, no mix.

result.summary: PASS with 3 non-blocking gaps. Static review, mix not run (hosted CI runs the tests). No @tag skip/TODO in any of the 4 files; no secrets; fixtures are per-test tenants (ctx!/tenant!), async:false. Route walk: 14 routes in @walk equal the 14 id routes in Routers.Instances (rebind-pins, cancel, reconstruct, advance-timer, history, timeline, pins, POST/GET attachments, GET/DELETE attachment, link, link-content, GET /:id); inventory test compares __authz_routes__/0 filtered on ':id' (paths stored as declared, method upper-case) so a new route fails it. Walk compares status+body+full sorted headers (only x-request-id/date masked, trace pinned), for widget, gadget and sentinel, for each role. Assumptions verified by reading: TASK_WORKER core_role_allows? lacks :InstancesCancel and :InstancesAdvanceTimer so 403 holds (authorization.ex 1601-1626); advance-timer on synthetic/random both go Scheduler.resolve_advance_target -> :no_pending_timer -> 404 (unchanged code); upload has no instance existence check and the attachments migration has no FK to instance_projections, so both ids take the same path, upload body ids/timestamps masked. Reconstruct: guard is synthetic?-or-sentinel only; tests assert absent/synthetic/sentinel -> :instance_not_found and projection-deleted real instance -> {:ok,_} and HTTP 200. T9: lock wait uses pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = current_database() AND wait_event_type='Lock' AND pid <> pg_backend_pid(), bounded 200x25ms, flunks on timeout; checkin releases the owned connection so Task does not share it via $callers; deterministic for the loser path (a false positive waiter only makes it pass vacuously, never flake-fail; M9 leaves an orphan projection for the minted id and fails the synthetic_shaped == [winner_id] assertion). Mutants killed statically: M1 (repro a x2, T2 list, T5 list, T8 length), M2 (walk history/timeline, repro b1*), M3 (T7 equal-id visible; changed-definition hidden), M4 (T5, T7, T8), M5 (walk cancel row, T3), M6 (walk reconstruct row, T4, T5 sentinel/synthetic), M6b (T5 projection-deleted, existing AC2/AC5), M7 (T7 cross-prefix test and generated-SQL test), M8 (walk byte comparison), M9 (T9 deterministic). M10 unkilled by design (route already 404s by content).
gaps_nonblocking: T8 does NOT kill a post-filter implementation as the spec claims: list orders by started_at desc, the 2 synthetic rows are the oldest, so a post-LIMIT filter would still return the 3 real ones across 2 pages. Fix: start the real instances BEFORE creating the synthetic ones (or interleave) and correct the spec sentence. Only M1 (removal) is killed by T8.
T7 'composes with where and limit' uses random uuids with order_by instance_id asc limit 2: a post-filter passes with probability 1/10 (flaky-vacuous). Use fixed ids that sort synthetic-first.

Attachment routes (esp. POST upload) assert only synthetic == random, not status, and an upload to a synthetic id persists an attachment; accepted residual (#2718), already stated in the spec. T2b(v) assumes rebind-pins query count is equal for synthetic vs random (spec says pins is 1 vs 2 only for GET /pins); unverified because tests were not run, CI will confirm. T9 stress test is probabilistic (deterministic test carries the kill).
